scripts.dev: concurrently "yarn workspace @project/webapp dev" "yarn workspace @project/shared dev" "yarn workspace @project/pb dev"
scripts.test: yarn workspace @project/shared test && yarn workspace @project/webapp test && yarn workspace @project/cli test && yarn run test:benchmark
scripts.test:watch: concurrently "yarn workspace @project/shared test:watch" "yarn workspace @project/webapp test:watch" "yarn workspace @project/cli test:watch"
scripts.lint:check: yarn workspaces foreach -A run lint && eslint benchmark
scripts.lint: yarn workspaces foreach -A run lint:fix && eslint benchmark --fix
scripts.typecheck: yarn workspaces foreach -A -t run typecheck && tsc --noEmit -p benchmark/tsconfig.json
scripts.format: yarn workspaces foreach -A run format && prettier --write "benchmark/**/*.{ts,json}"
scripts.format:check: yarn workspaces foreach -A run format:check && prettier --check "benchmark/**/*.{ts,json}"
scripts.precommit: yarn run format && yarn run lint && yarn run typecheck && yarn run test
scripts.clean: yarn workspaces foreach -R run clean && rm -rf pocketbase/pocketbase
